novel_features.name: Budget scout
novel_features.description: Band market listings by hourly/day rate so you can see what a city+activity actually costs.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local search snapshot and offline histogram math the website never exposes.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when planning a budget before deep-diving individual venues.

novel_features.name: Capacity bands
novel_features.description: Histogram of guest capacity for a synced market so you can re-cut when headcount changes.
novel_features.rationale: Capacity is only a live filter on the web; banding needs the full local hit set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when guest count is the binding constraint, not price.

novel_features.name: Shortlist compare
novel_features.description: Join your favorites board to listing attributes for a sortable offline comparison table.
novel_features.rationale: fav_board returns IDs only; joining to price, capacity, and instant-book needs local listing cache plus cookie auth.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when deciding among saved venues without reopening browser tabs.

novel_features.name: Multi-city market pulse
novel_features.description: Cross-city rollup of median price, listing density, instant-book share, and capacity quantiles.
novel_features.rationale: Only possible by aggregating multiple local (city, activity) sync keys.
novel_features.example: peerspace-pp-cli markets pulse --city Paris --city Lyon --activity meetup --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when comparing host cities for the same event type.

novel_features.name: Shortlist delta
novel_features.description: Show favorites added, removed, or changed since the last sync snapshot.
novel_features.rationale: Website favorites have no history; SQLite snapshots make deltas first-class.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to see what changed on your board without scrolling hearts.

novel_features.name: Neighborhood market cut
novel_features.description: Per-neighborhood listing stats plus optional --vibe tech keyword signals from descriptions (WiFi, projector, transit) and a built-in tech-cluster map.
novel_features.rationale: Elasticsearch hits in SQLite enable GROUP BY neighborhood with no public analytics API.
novel_features.example: peerspace-pp-cli markets neighborhoods --city Paris --activity meetup --vibe tech --json
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to pick tech-friendly neighborhoods before refining a shortlist.

novel_features.name: Similar-to-shortlist
novel_features.description: Find local listings near a favorite on capacity, price, and neighborhood.
novel_features.rationale: Mechanical similarity over the local hit set — no LLM, no website feature.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a favorite is booked or too expensive and you need substitutes.

novel_features.name: Project scout pack
novel_features.description: Combine project location metadata with fitting listings from the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Projects and search are separate API surfaces; only the CLI joins them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a saved project needs a ready market pack.

novel_features.name: Sync coverage
novel_features.description: Report which market query keys are present, row counts, and last-synced times.
novel_features.rationale: Offline commands fail silently without a sync metadata plane; the website has none.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before scout/markets/sql so agents fail closed on empty markets.

novel_features.name: Coordination pulse
novel_features.description: One cookie-auth shot: message thread count, favorites summary, profile identity, and optional recent shortlist activity.
novel_features.rationale: Three authenticated GETs the UI never composes into a single agent payload.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a daily inbox + shortlist health check without opening Peerspace.

novel_features.name: Venue fit recommender
novel_features.description: Rank synced venues for tech meetups/workshops by headcount, date window, budget, and vibe keywords.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local multi-field scoring over the hit set; the website only sorts relevance cards.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when an agent or planner needs a ranked shortlist for a tech event, not a raw search scroll.

novel_features.name: Shortlist proposal bridge
novel_features.description: Export favorites as clean JSON plus a markdown block (price, capacity, amenities, fit notes) for Eventbrite/Luma/Slack.
novel_features.rationale: Joins fav IDs to listing attributes and formats a handoff pack no website export provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when turning a Peerspace shortlist into a Luma/Eventbrite draft or Slack approval message.

novel_features.name: Shortlist venue drift
novel_features.description: Track price and availability-field changes on favorites over time (Luma-style watch).
novel_features.rationale: Needs historical snapshots of joined favorite attributes in SQLite.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to catch rate spikes or lost instant-book before you pitch a venue.

novel_features.name: Amenity gap analysis
novel_features.description: Surface missing tech-event must-haves (WiFi, AV/projector, late access, flexible seating, transit) on any shortlist.
novel_features.rationale: Maps amenity/keyword presence across favorites against a tech-event checklist stored locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before finalizing a venue to see what each shortlist option lacks for a tech event.

novel_features.name: Multi-city campaign scout
novel_features.description: Cross-city comparison with top venue options per city under shared tech-event constraints.
novel_features.rationale: Fans out over multiple local market keys with one constraint set; website is multi-tab only.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for multi-city meetup tours or choosing a host city under the same constraints.

narrative.headline: Tech-event venue scout for Peerspace: search and filter spaces, rank fit for meetups/workshops, compare shortlists, export proposal packs for Luma/Eventbrite/Slack, and query markets offline.
narrative.value_prop: Peerspace has no public API. peerspace-pp-cli wraps live venue search behind Surf transport, syncs listings into SQLite, then compounds them for tech meetup and workshop planners: budget/capacity bands, amenity gap analysis, multi-city campaign scouts, shortlist drift, and clean JSON/markdown export for Eventbrite/Luma drafts or Slack approval.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public search and filters work without login (Surf clears Cloudflare). Favorites, profile, messages, and projects need a browser session: run `peerspace-pp-cli auth login --chrome` while logged into peerspace.com in Chrome.

quickstart.comment: Verify the CLI boots and transport is wired
Discover space types and amenities for an activity
Import Chrome cookies for favorites and profile

troubleshoots.symptom: HTTP 403 or Cloudflare challenge HTML on venues list
troubleshoots.fix: Browser-Chrome transport is default; retry; if still blocked, run auth login --chrome for clearance cookies
Run peerspace-pp-cli auth login --chrome while logged into peerspace.com
Run venues list for that city+activity first, then peerspace-pp-cli sync coverage --json

narrative.when_to_use: Use when planning tech meetups, workshops, or community events: scout venues by headcount/budget/date, score fit, watch favorites for price changes, and hand off shortlists to Luma/Eventbrite workflows.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to place or pay for bookings — booking checkout is not in the captured surface
Do not use for host listing management or calendar sync — host tools were not captured
Do not expect a stable official API contract; endpoints are reverse-engineered from site traffic
